name: Kerne Synthetic Dollar
description: kUSD is a yield-bearing synthetic dollar on Base, minted 1:1 from USDC through a Peg Stability Module and designed to stay redeemable at all times. Backing is at least 1:1, attested in an EIP-191 signed proof of reserves every hour, and can be recomputed on-chain with the free tool at kerne.fi/verify-anything.
